series_title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
synthesis_notes: The synthesis strategy focuses on high-impact thematic symmetry and explicit cause-and-effect narrative loops across the series. Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_01 creates an intimate emotional mirror between Episode 14 (where Alexander vows over bloody wash water that Juliana will never bleed for him again) and Episode 29 (where Juliana, locked in a stone cell after losing her mother's heirlooms, uses Alexander's memory as her shield). Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_02 delivers a visceral revenge promise: following the arson of Blackwood cottage in Episode 18, Alexander's smoldering oath jumps 18 episodes forward to Episode 36, where he sets a strict two-day countdown for the usurpers. Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_03 crafts an exhilarating political thriller arc, bridging Alexander's disclosure of the Iberian front betrayal in Episode 35 directly into his triumphant, smoke-draped cathedral gatecrash in Episode 42. In all three candidates, element boundary cuts are strictly observed to preserve verbatim dialogue integrity and ensure precise audio waveform synchronization for video editors.
